- Max. voltage per verification scale interval: 3,25 μV → 3.25 μV
- Min. voltage per verification scale interval: 0,4 μV → 0.4 μV

- Maximum number of connected platforms: 2 (standard 1) → value 2, or string? Structured: value 2 with note? Better: value: 2, and maybe a separate characteristic standard_number_of_connected_platforms: 1. Hmm. Could be a string "2 (standard 1)". Rule says numbers not strings. I'll use value 2 and add separate note? The schema doesn't have notes. I could record max_connected_platforms: 2 and typical/standard value 1. Let me keep it simple: maximum_number_of_connected_platforms: {value: 2, unit_symbol: null}. And maybe omit the standard. Actually I can include two characteristics: maximum_number_of_connected_platforms (2) and standard_number_of_connected_platforms (1). That captures it.
- Multi-range: YES → string "YES" — multi_range_support: {value: true}? Value can be string. I'll use "YES" string or boolean true. Schema says value: number | {min,max} | string. Boolean not listed. Use string "YES".
- OIML class: III
- Operating temperature: –10 °C / +40 °C → {min: -10, max: 40}, unit °C
- Relative humidity (not condensing): 10% / 80% → {min: 10, max: 80}, unit "%"
- Power supply: 100-240VAC 50-60Hz → split:
  - power_supply_voltage: {min:100, max:240}, unit V, type AC
  - power_supply_frequency: {min:50, max:60}, unit Hz
  - power_supply_type: "AC"
- Optional power supply: External 12-24VDC → optional_power_supply_voltage: {min:12, max:24}, unit V DC; optional_power_supply_type: "DC external"
- Battery power supply: Internal rechargeable battery → string
- Power consumption: 25 W → 25 W
- Display: 7" colour → string "7\" colour" or display_size: 7 with unit "in"? Value "7-inch colour" — I'd record display: {value: "7\" colour"} — hmm quote in string fine. Or display_size: 7, unit_symbol: "in". Simpler: display_type: "7\" colour".
- Ingress protection rating: IP 68 / 69 → string "IP 68 / 69" — could be two values. Keep as string.
- Housing: AISI304 stainless steel → string
- Keypad: membrane → string
- Net weight: 4.7 kg → 4.7 kg
- Interfaces: long string — keep as string.

Devices and functions — initial zero setting ≤ 20% Max → initial_zero_setting: {min: null, max: 20}, unit "%" — reference "Max". Zero tracking ≤ 4% Max → zero_tracking: {min: null, max: 4}, unit "%". These are optional; I'll include them as type_level with unit "%" and note reference. Maybe include as characteristics: initial_zero_setting_limit: 20%, zero_tracking_limit: 4%. Keep unit_symbol "%".

Software version: 181212 HX7 → software_version: "181212 HX7"

Alibi memory: up to 500 000 weighing results → alibi_memory_capacity: 500000.

No model family — single model PUE HX7. So omit model_family (schema says include ONLY if cert covers >1 model variant). Single type designation: PUE HX7.

Components: "Essential parts" table is documentation, not components. Not sub-assemblies. Omit components? The indicator itself... no named sub-assemblies with types. Skip.

Include as test_reports entry with role documentation_file? The schema includes documentation_file as a role. Include with id, date null... but rule 8: omit missing fields. I'll include date omitted.

Could put person_title null. Actually maybe include the signatory separately? Schema doesn't have it. I could note Klenovský as signatory — not in schema. Leave out or... The certificate says "Person responsible: Jan Kalandra". Keep that. Omit phone/email/website (not present).

OIML issuer ID: CZ1 appears in cert number. Both certificate.oiml_issuer_id and issuing_authority.oiml_issuer_id → "CZ1".

Page total: 7. Scheme: "A". Project number: not stated — omit.

- zero_tracking: {min: null, max: 4}, "%"

I'll include main ones: rs232_connector, usb_connector, ethernet_connector, digital_io_connector. Optional ones maybe skip to avoid bloat. Actually, moderate inclusion is fine. I'll include standard connections only.
